title: Frappe ERPNext 11.0.0-beta before 15.121.4 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions from 11.0.0-beta up to but not including 15.121.4 contain a missing authorization vulnerability. This flaw allows authenticated users, including those with minimal roles or portal access, to read POS Profile cashier lists by exploiting a POS endpoint that lacks proper record permission checks. The vulnerability enables unauthorized access to cashier data by sending crafted requests referencing out-of-scope POS Profiles.
